name: Stormbringer: Voltaic Bursts raises Shock's periodic share (#707)
contract: #707. Voltaic Bursts (705639) is aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) with EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), EffectBasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50%, and EffectSpellClassMask [0, 0, 268435456], which matches Shock Hidden Passive (707058, SpellFamilyFlags [0, 0, 268435456]) and nothing else. Shock's own tooltip computes its periodic part as ($560336d*1000/$560336T1)*($707058m1)% of the initial damage, so 707058's effect 0 value is the authoritative percentage per tick: EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10. Shock's DoT 560336 has DurationIndex 36 (1000 ms) and EffectAmplitude 500 ms, so it ticks twice and its total is 2 x that percentage of the hit. The module cast the DoT with a hardcoded damage/10, so the modifier could never reach it. The fix reads 707058's live effect value with Unit::CalculateSpellDamage, which runs Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers and therefore SPELLMOD_EFFECT1. Shock rank 9 (504634) is used because its damage (EffectBasePoints 433 + int(7 x 3.85) level scaling + irand(1, 45), i.e. 460..504) makes the per-tick integer truncation negligible; no absolute damage number is asserted, only the DoT total divided by the same cast's direct damage, which is 0.20 at a 10% share and 0.30 at a 15% share.

steps.label: BASELINE: Shock Hidden Passive's periodic share is 10 (Spell.dbc 9 + 1)
Cast time (2000 ms) plus the two DoT ticks (500 ms and 1000 ms)
BASELINE: without Voltaic Bursts the DoT totals 20% of the hit (2 ticks x 10%)
Voltaic Bursts' passive aura is applied
Voltaic Bursts raises the hidden passive's share to 15 (10 x 1.5, Spell.dbc 49 + 1 = +50%)
Cast time plus the two DoT ticks
Direct damage of the boosted cast alone
DISCRIMINATING: with Voltaic Bursts the DoT totals 30% of the hit (2 ticks x 15%), not 20%
